globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: a tailored navy-blue blazer over a crisp light-blue open-collar formal shirt, no tie (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a seamless, plain, very light ivory off-white studio backdrop (almost white, with only a faint warm tint), brightly and evenly lit from edge to edge with no falloff, no vignette, no shadows, no texture and no objects - nothing else in the frame; identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Lively but controlled hand gestures kept close to his body at chest height, elbows bent and near his sides, hands never pushed toward the camera and never stretched out to the side; small confident nods and a bright smile on emphasis; he stays standing in the same spot, at the same distance from the camera, throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, clear and energetic, continuous speech at a brisk trainer's pace, NO background music, NO sound effects, NO silence at the start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He stays in the same spot with his face and upper body fully visible at all times; NO arms, elbows or shoulders cut off by the frame edges, NO oversized hands, NO thin or lanky body, NO wide-angle lens distortion, NO arm stretched out to the frame edge, NO arms, elbows or shoulders touching or cut by the frame edges, NO furniture, NO bookshelves, NO plants, NO lamps, NO props, NO objects behind him, NO icons or graphics, NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, NO other people
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical. A natural MEDIUM-WIDE shot framed from mid-thigh up: he is STANDING, centred, at a normal distance with a natural portrait-lens look (no wide-angle distortion); there is always clear empty backdrop between his arms and BOTH side edges of the frame (about a hand's width on each side), and clear space above his head. Eye level, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. Soft, bright, even high-key light: a soft frontal key light on his face with soft fill, no harsh shadows, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, identical exposure and white balance in every scene. TRUE-TO-LIFE BODY: natural adult proportions that match his face - broad shoulders about three head-widths across, a solid average build that fills the jacket (not slim, not lanky, not narrow-shouldered), hands of normal natural size in proportion to his face and body, relaxed natural fingers
globalStyle.delivery: Highly energetic, enthusiastic legal trainer leading a masterclass, like a motivating coach talking straight to camera to law students: bright smile, lively eyes, confident emphasis on key words, brisk clear pace, a tiny pause after each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word, never add words

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing centred against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, medium-wide shot from mid-thigh up, clear space between his arms and both frame edges, natural proportions, speaking energetically to camera with his hands close to his body at chest height, same position, size, outfit and framing as every other clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Every civil case in India begins with one question. Not 'Who is right?' Not 'How much can I claim?'

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing centred against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, medium-wide shot from mid-thigh up, natural proportions, clear space between his arms and both frame edges. Once while he speaks he briefly glances toward the LEFT side of the frame, as if checking the slide beside him, and looks back to camera; both hands stay IN FRONT OF HIS CHEST the whole time with natural open-palm gestures, elbows at his sides. He does not reach, point or step to the side, his body stays facing the camera in the same spot, no text.
scenes.dialogue: The first question is: do you have a cause of action? Get this wrong, and your suit can be thrown out before the defendant even files a written statement.
